findings.problem: Byte-identical to the English source, so the repo guard fails: `node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs` -> `[fr] is not an English stub (no value identical to the source)` at locale-parity.test.mjs:1390 (assertion :1402) lists `ui.teamBridge.json: ui.teamBridge.profile.agent_badge`. The word is CORRECT - « agent » is the glossary rendering for the term and matches the rest of the fr namespace (thread.withheld, plan.body, sender.unknown_agent). The defect is the missing scoped exemption for a legitimate French cognate, not the copy.
findings.fix: Do not change the fr value. Add one row to IDENTICAL_OK in scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs, beside the existing fr cognate rows: ["fr:ui.teamBridge.profile.agent_badge", "French glossary term for agent is « agent » — the same spelling as English; scoped to fr so the other locales still translate it"]. Then re-run the parity suite.

findings.problem: 「个人」 is the adjective/account-type sense ('personal, individual') - the prefix of 个人资料 - not the noun for a person. This namespace already uses 人员 for people in prose (compose.label 添加人员或智能体; create.channel_description). Under a name and title the badge can be parsed as an account type rather than an identity marker. Still understandable, so non-gating.
findings.fix: 「真人」 - the established Chinese contrast to 智能体/机器人 on AI surfaces (真人客服), and it reads as an identity badge, not as 个人资料's prefix.

findings.problem: 'Con người' is the collective/abstract noun for humankind; a one-word identity badge in Vietnamese product copy reads more naturally with a concrete noun. Meaning survives, so non-gating.
findings.fix: 「Người thật」 (real person - the settled human-vs-bot contrast) or 「Người dùng」 if the user framing is preferred. Keep 「Tác nhân」 unchanged.

findings.problem: Label and clock time run together with no separator. The four other locales that mark the value use a colon (fr « Heure locale : », es « Hora local: », ru « Местное время: », vi « Giờ địa phương: »), and the card renders icon + label + time, so the missing colon reads as a run-on. RTL order itself is correct: logical order, no manual bidi controls.
Same run-on label/value with no separator. Hindi UI convention puts a colon here, and every other locale that marks the value does; the label and the formatted time should not read as one phrase.
This control closes the hover card, not the profile record; 「个人资料」 names the data. Understandable as an aria-label, but it says 'close the personal profile' where 「关闭资料卡」 says what disappears.
findings.fix: 「关闭资料卡」; for symmetry either keep 「打开{name}的个人资料」 (acceptable) or use 资料卡 in both.

findings.problem: The context sidecar asks for the account name inside the phrase rather than as a separate fragment; the colon makes it a label:value pair. Grammar justifies the workaround (an undeclinable display name cannot take the genitive after профиль), so this is a nit, not a major.
findings.fix: 「Открыть профиль пользователя {name}」 if a native reviewer prefers the apposition; otherwise keep the current wording.

findings.note: Observation, not a defect: all eight locales repeat the visible row label ({name}) inside the open_profile aria-label, so label-in-name holds. Verified against the rail trigger (team-bridge-rail.tsx), whose visible content is the person's name; team-bridge-profile-card.tsx:143 applies the aria-label.

Observation: the ur values contain no U+200E/U+200F/U+2066-U+2069 control characters (code-point scan), per the ur guide's 'no manual bidi controls' rule. '{name} کا پروفائل کھولیں' is correct logical order for RTL with an embedded Latin name.

Observation: English 'Message' is both noun and verb; the context note resolves it as an action, and all seven translations chose the action label, matching each locale's shipped ui.teamBridge.people.message (Envoyer un message / Enviar un mensaje / 发消息 / Написать / Nhắn tin / پیغام بھیجیں / संदेश भेजें).

ru.note: One nit on the colon form of open_profile. 'Агент' and 'Местное время' match the glossary and the ru guide; no space before the colon, per the ru guide.

vi.note: One non-gating finding on human_badge. 'Tác nhân' is the glossary term and matches sender.unknown_agent; 'Giờ địa phương' follows the guide's rule that địa phương is reserved for timezone-local; all values NFC.

ur.note: One non-gating finding on local_time's missing separator. RTL order correct, no manual bidi controls, Latin digits per the guide, آپ imperative درست; 'شخص' matches sender.unknown_person.

hi.note: One non-gating finding on local_time's missing separator. Polite imperative ओ forms, nukta kept in प्रोफ़ाइल, 'व्यक्ति' matches sender.unknown_person, 'एजेंट' matches the glossary.
